theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_ip_wt_slice_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ f : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Continuous (fun σ : ℝ => ∫ w in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons σ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ w))) * θ (x + r • w) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)))
